name: wave-mcp-server
description: Wave Accounting MCP connector for invoices, estimates, customers, products, sales taxes, payments, the chart of accounts, and double-entry bookkeeping.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Claude and Codex to Wave Accounting invoices, estimates, and books.
interface.longDescription: A standalone Wave Accounting MCP connector covering Wave's public GraphQL API in full: invoices and payments, estimates and deposits, customers, vendors, products, sales taxes, the chart of accounts, and double-entry bookkeeping transactions. Requires WAVE_ACCESS_TOKEN. Write tools are gated behind WAVE_ALLOW_WRITES.
defaultPrompt: Show me every unpaid Wave invoice over $500.
Create a Wave invoice for Acme Corp for 10 hours of consulting.
Log a $45.99 office supplies expense paid from Business Checking.
